readingMap.evidence: Produce a measured configuration register, mass budget and envelope drawing; resolve exclusions and in-match restrictions.
Create a removable bumper assembly and inspection drawing; do not assume last year's construction or mass treatment.
List exact motor/controller/servo part numbers and pairings before selecting a Java vendor library.
Trace battery, protection, conductor, connector, distribution and radio power paths in a schematic; assign a qualified reviewer.
Record roboRIO image, radio revision, signal authority and disable propagation; distinguish simulation from real IO.
Collect exact component ratings, schematic, regulation and relief evidence; keep stored-energy procedures with qualified mentors.
Maintain the complete configuration inventory and re-inspection decision record; software test output is not inspection approval.

javaBoundary: Java is the chosen teaching language. WPILib 2026.2.1 desktop tests do not establish historical image/vendor/runtime compatibility or hardware approval.
limits: Selected facts and reading locators only; never an automated legality certificate
